documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 performance with income growing by 79.91% year-on-year to INR135.57 crores and EBITDA increasing by 65.46% to INR23.62 crores. Management noted robust order inflow, securing 11 orders worth INR209.24 crores during the half year, bringing the total order book to over INR565.80 crores. The company expects full-year revenue for FY27 to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores, while maintaining a PAT margin guidance range of 9% to 12%. Management also highlighted that around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses to mitigate raw material price pressures. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for H1 FY27, with total income growing 79.91% year-on-year to ₹135.57 Cr and net profit increasing 45.09% to ₹13.65 Cr.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the order book by the end of the year to be between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: Management guides for a top line of INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

guidance.claim: The company expects PAT margins to be sustained between 9% and 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management projects a minimum 30% year-on-year rise in revenue going forward.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to be maintained between 18% and 20%.
guidance.quote: It will be maintained between 18% to 20%.

guidance.claim: Peak revenue from both plants combined is expected to reach INR 600 crores to INR 650 crores by FY29.
guidance.quote: It will be INR600 crores to INR650 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across the transformer industry is very good, supported by transmission, renewable energy, and industrial expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: We are encouraged by the demand environment across the transformer industry, supported by continued investments in transmission and distribution infrastructure, renewable energy integration and industrial expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Market information indicates good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflow remained healthy during the first half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging, and the company continues to progress in line with its targets for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that transformer demand is very high and expects it to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand across the globe and in India for transformers is described as very good.
demand_outlook.quote: And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good. Demand is very good.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand environment over the next 2 to 3 years remains very high.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its geographic presence into Maharashtra, further broadening its customer and market base.
capex_expansion.quote: We also expanded our geographic presence into Maharashtra, further broadening our customer and market base.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter, expanding total capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: I would all like to brief touch upon our new Kannur manufacturing facility, which became operational during the previous quarter. The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

capex_expansion.claim: The anticipated capex for the tank manufacturing facility is around INR 20 crores to INR 22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects the new tank manufacturing facility construction to be completed before March.
capex_expansion.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27 primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs for key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70–75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses, providing protection against significant movements in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: Management remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix, and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price increases are absorbed and passed on to buyers through a price variation clause.
margins_costs.quote: So the margin was able to maintain and it was the reason it was absorbed, and it was passed out.

margins_costs.claim: Almost 80% to 85% of the orders held are covered with a price variation clause.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The peak revenue potential for both plants combined is up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book product mix comprises distribution transformers at 16% to 17%, power transformers at 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers at 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Additional capacity from the Kannur facility is expected to support the execution of the growing order book and enable participation in larger transformer opportunities.
orders_capacity.quote: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR 590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while non-government orders represent 69.9%.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91% of the order book, followed by distribution transformers at 17.84% and inverter duty transformers at 5.25%.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%. This is followed by distribution transformers at INR105.27 crores, representing 17.84% and inverter duty transformer at INR30.96 crores, representing 5.25%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating INR 195.64 crores during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the total order book, INR 377 crores are scheduled to be completed before March.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR590 crores as per the delivery requirement of the customers is INR377 crores should be completed before March.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the new plant is currently between 20% and 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, yes. The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

capital_allocation.claim: Term loans will be raised from banks for the tank manufacturing facility capex.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we will be raising term loans for that.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debtor cycle of around 80 to 100 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Debtors cycle will be around 90 to 100 days -- 80 to 100 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Timing differences between input cost increases and price variation clause adjustments can impact margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve peak revenue from the expanded manufacturing capacity by next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, yes. It is expected in next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to utilize the new Kannur facility up to 80% next year.
management_commitments.quote: And next year, almost 80%, I think we should utilize.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to migrate to the main board at an appropriate time.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we have a plan. In an appropriate time, we will definitely come into the main board.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to receive statutory approvals for the tank facility before the end of next month.
management_commitments.quote: I think we will get the approval before end of next month.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
